notes.title: Ping Profit Demo Update
notes.notes:
🔧 What’s New
🧭 Tutorial Toggle
You can now disable the tutorial and jump straight into the action!

⚙️ Performance Optimizations Smoother gameplay and improved frame rates—especially for lower-spec systems. We know it is not perfect, and more optimizations are on the way!

📊 Updated Server Management Types UI
The UI now aligns with the rest of the game and includes smoother transitions and cleaner interactions.

📐 Grid Placement System
Racks can now be placed more easily with a new grid system for smoother setup and layout.

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45618170/d91a6920771fda7895ce59209fa585327ce8fff4.png"]
[hr][/hr]💬 A Note From the Team
This demo represents just a small sliver of the game we’re building. Thank you to everyone who played, shared feedback, and reported bugs through the in-game form (found in the pause menu)!

Here are a few quick responses to common questions:

Is this the full game?
Not even close! This demo is a limited preview of what we’re working on. Here are some high-level features we’re planning to expand and build toward:

🖥️ More Server Types 

🎮 Mini Games

🏢 New Levels with Unique Room Types

🌱 Tech Tree Progression

👨‍💼 Expanded Employee Management

📈 Advanced Charts & In-Game Reporting Metrics

⚡ New Systems: Electrical Rooms, Generators, Switches, and More

Will there be other languages?
Yes! Localization is on our roadmap, but we want to finish more core gameplay first.

Will there be more optimizations and improvements? 

We’re improving our foundation and stability before expanding core systems. Build Mode is in development—allowing players to fully customize their data center in Free Mode. It’s a critical part of both sandbox and campaign progression.

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45618170/f3522e7ff0d705a5b6db7648b415a1cf9ab491c4.png"]
[hr][/hr]🚀 Coming Soon: Early Access
We’re heading toward Early Access and would love your help shaping the journey. Expect regular updates, new content, and plenty of ways to get involved!

notes.title: 🛠️ Ping Profit Demo Update
notes.notes:
🔧 Bug Fixes

Tutorial Updates – Smoother hand motions and clearer instructional messages.
Electric Panel Bug – Fixed disappearing menu; panel is now properly upgradeable.
AC Menu Fix – Menu now opens reliably and accepts input as expected.
Selling Window Exploit – You can no longer sell your window for profit (you cheeky tycoons); upgrades only!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45618170/4f59b2c3286cc9d66174035dc2d3668fdb94f847.png
Rack Placement Goals – The rack goal should now only trigger once instead of twice.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45618170/b7297d3262aa90c3bf03ed6276cbd6cb92d515cd.png
Volume Control – You can now adjust volume with arrow keys, and the slider is much smoother.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45618170/ff0bf5d4c3f92754cf649c6330b0a29c92ca293d.png


💡 Environment Updates

Game Balance Tweaks – Adjusted breakage logic, heat scaling, and amperage balance for smoother gameplay.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45618170/67dc38629c1ce59821b9cec54ade49bbd79e77bd.png  {STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45618170/68e779f180d4b2e306706494dbfc6a0dcedadf40.png  {STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45618170/1cb7f030c460fb264a59ef8e45765a5946f14b3f.png
Lighting – Improved lighting in the basement to enhance clarity and mood.
Shadows – More accurate rack shadows for better spatial feedback.
Object Highlights – Enhanced visibility on interactive items. 

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45618170/5c70ed10f3e730eb22340df9652637134d280fcc.png

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45618170/010777b32dc240949e947da6b520282f32b2b8d0.png
💬 Feedback Spotlight + What’s Ahead
Your feedback continues to shape the future of Ping Profit, and we’ve already started evaluating several requested features for the next updates:

Updated Hotkey Integration – Better keyboard support for fast actions and smoother gameplay.
Additional UI Improvements – Ongoing tweaks to enhance clarity, feedback, and overall visual flow.
Togglable Tutorial – We’re working on giving you the option to turn the tutorial on or off at will.
Camera Functionality – Improved control, smoother movement, and better angle options are on our radar.

Some of these will appear in future demo patches, others may roll into the full game — keep that feedback coming!

Thanks for helping shape Ping Profit into something truly unique. Every comment, bug report, and wishlist helps push us forward.


📌 Don’t forget to wishlist Ping Profit if you haven’t already
